notes.title: Update 1.9v
notes.content:
[h1]Hope - Update 1.9 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Item[/h2]
- Greatsword

[h2]New Models[/h2]
- Human (1, 2, 3)  
  * Human skin tone base, but each comes in slightly different color variations.

[h2]Animations[/h2]
- Melee weapon animation updated

[h2]Gameplay Features[/h2]
- Adjusted zombie item mechanics  
- Added support for more screen resolutions

[h2]Languages[/h2]

- Fixed some mistranslations in Korean

[h2]New Map[/h2]
- Sandbox

notes.title: Update 1.8v
notes.content:
[h1]Hope - Update 1.8 Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SLD2X1c.png[/img]

[h2]Animation Changes[/h2]
- Updated drink usage animation.

[h2]Model Changes[/h2]
- Improved bullet casing model.

[h2]UI Changes[/h2]
- Updated Credits UI.

[h2]Gameplay Features[/h2]
- Quick item switching added  
- Key binding now saves  
- Crosshair is now always visible and circular  
- Gore effects upgraded  
- Expanded Player Config options (adjust XYZ scale and position)  
- Ejected casings now have improved physics  
- PKP can now cause dismemberment  
- PKP fire rate changed (0.07 → 0.06)  
- Bullet impact force increased (3000 → 6000)  
- AI behavior tree updated  
- AI perception logic improved  
  - Before: AI detected all enemies in their vision  
  - After: AI reacts even if just one enemy is seen (faster response)  
- Button click sound updated
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6MGlhqa.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed ammo bug for AA-12 (ammo would reset to 30 when dropped and picked up again)  
- Fixed bug where player couldn’t stand while holding shield in crouch  
- Fixed bug where player became stuck after exiting ragdoll  
- Fixed zombie duplication bug

[h2]Map Updates[/h2]
- Trench map reworked  
- Forest map foliage render distance adjusted
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J3vzjU0.png[/img]

[h2]Message from the Developer[/h2]

I'm now shifting focus toward mod support and occasional bug fixes.  
Why? Because I’m starting a new project!  
I once made a psychological horror game, and I plan to rebuild it from scratch.

But don’t worry — this doesn’t mean I’m abandoning Hope.  
After mod support is complete, bug patches will continue,  
and if multiple developers come together in the future,  
[b]Hope 2[/b] is something I’d seriously consider.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DNfXCwS.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.7v
notes.content:
[h1]Hope - Update 1.7 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]1. Gameplay Features[/h2]

[b]1. Fixed the slow-motion feature in Playground Mode.[/b]  
[b]2. Added key binding options.[/b]  
[b]3. Added durability to body armor.[/b]  
[b]4. Increased inventory space.[/b]  
[b]5. Added collision sounds for ragdoll bodies.[/b]  
[b]6. Added sound effects to UI buttons.[/b]  
[b]7. Added new stat tracking.[/b]  
[b]8. Improved gore system.[/b]  
* When an arm is severed, blood will now also appear on the upper part.  
[b]9. Characters now scream upon death.[/b]  
[b]10. Adjusted bullet gravity values.[/b]  
[b]11. Fixed issue where AI checked every frame whether the target was dead.[/b]  
[b]12. Added a Credits section to the menu.[/b]  
[b]13. Improved AI healing logic.[/b]  
* AI now heals when their current health is below 100%.  
[b]14. Each AI now has a different turning speed.[/b]  
[b]15. Animation speed is now based on movement speed.[/b]  
[b]16. Added new ragdoll types.[/b]  
* Animation-based ragdoll / basic ragdoll  
[b]17. Added collision sounds when dropping items.[/b]

[h2]2. New Items[/h2]

- [b]Body Armor Repair Kit[/b]  
- [b]Energy Drink[/b]  
* Increases movement speed by 1.4x upon use

[h2]3. Follow Development on Discord[/h2]

[b][url=https://discord.gg/gNvn33Wg8]▶ Join our official Discord server[/url][/b]

notes.title: Update 1.2.5v
notes.content:
[h1]Hope - Update 1.2.5 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]1. Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

[b]You can now preview map images and descriptions before starting the game[/b]  
[b]Fixed issue where the new Wire Action model collided with the player[/b]  
[b]Improved AI logic for picking up items[/b]  
[b]Pressing F now plays a sound[/b]  
[b]Picking up or dropping weapons now triggers a sound effect[/b]

[h2]2. New Maps[/h2]

- Added a map with multiple pillars  
- Added a very wide and flat map

[h2]3. Bug Fixes[/h2]

- When AI dies and drops a weapon, it will now be removed properly in Playground Mode when the delete button is pressed  
- Added missing key binding descriptions in the settings menu

[h2]4. Visual Updates[/h2]

[b]Reduced the length of the rope in Wire Action to minimize excessive swinging[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.2v
notes.content:
[h1]Hope - Update 1.2 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]1. Improvements & Changes[/h2]

[b]AI Behavior Improved[/b]  
[b]Wire Action model updated[/b]  
[b]Weapon physics system revamped[/b]  

[b]Weapons can now be dropped and picked up (by both players and AI) To Press "G"[/b] 
* AI will switch to a dropped weapon if it’s better than their current one.

[b]Most maps now include grass and trees[/b]  
[b]New Melee Weapon Added: "Spear"[/b]  
* The longest and most powerful melee weapon in the game (as of Update 1.2).

[b]New confirmation popup appears when opening external links[/b]  
[b]Playground Mode: You can now see AI movement points on the map[/b]  
* AI chooses one randomly and moves toward it.

[h2]2. Coming in the Next Update[/h2]

- AI will take cover behind structures  
- AI will be able to use mounted weapons  
- New maps: [i]Apartment[/i], [i]City[/i], and a new one for Playground Mode

[h2]3. Join Our Discord[/h2]

Want to follow development or receive important news?  
[b][url=https://discord.gg/gNvn33Wg8]Join our official Discord server[/url][/b]

[h2]4. A Message from the Developer[/h2]

[i]Originally, "Hope" was designed as an open-world territory war game.[/i]  
[i]The idea was to fight across vast land, loot, build shelters, and capture regions like in real wars.[/i]  
[i]But developing such a large-scale game solo proved too difficult.[/i]  
[i]That’s why it transformed into the immersive simulation FPS it is today.[/i]

[i]If there's an opportunity in the future, I plan to release an open-world territory war DLC for about $2~3.[/i]  
[i]And although no one had purchased the game when I was preparing this update...[/i]  
[i]If you’re reading this because you bought the game — thank you so much. I’ll keep working hard.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.1v
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Game Mode - Playground[/b][/h2]
You can now create your own battles by spawning or deleting AIs from a spectator perspective.
You can check game time, camera speed, and AI information. The game time feature is still under development and will be improved in future updates.

[h2][b]Improved Sensitivity Settings[/b][/h2]
Spectators now also follow the sensitivity setting values.

[h2][b]Zombie Item Improvement[/b][/h2]
Spawns a clone similar to yourself, but without body armor or headgear. The model is replaced with a fixed zombie model.

[h2][b]AI Improvements[/b][/h2]
Some AI functions have been slightly modified.

[h2][b]Friendly Fire[/b][/h2]
A new friendly fire option has been added to the settings.

[h2][b]Translation Improvements[/b][/h2]
Minor adjustments have been made to the Korean language.

[h2][b]Filter Adjustments[/b][/h2]
The main menu filters have been improved.
